fusions.name: Dead Steady
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fletcher's Grip
fusions.desc: Looses a steady arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Locked Elbow
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 35% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Wavers
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
